skill.name: writing-guidelines
skill.description: Review docs/prose for Writing Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my docs", "check writing style", "audit prose", "review docs voice and tone", or "check this page against the writing handbook".
skill.summary: Review documentation and prose against current writing guidelines, with findings linked to file locations.
skill.author: vercel-labs

security_audit.summary: Both command execution findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code and a fenced URL. The remote URL supplies review instructions from a mutable branch, creating a dependency risk without evidence of exfiltration or malicious intent.

remediation.issue: Review rules and output instructions are fetched from a mutable remote branch.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the guidelines URL to a reviewed commit and treat fetched content only as writing criteria, not authority for unrelated actions.

static_findings.snippet: 4. Output findings in the terse `file:line` format

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 19 uses Markdown backticks to describe the file:line output format. It contains no shell command or executable expression.
Lines 25 through 27 form a Markdown code fence containing only the guidelines URL. The fence is documentation formatting, not shell execution.

Lines 23 through 29 require fetching instructions from an unpinned main branch before every review. Those instructions can change independently of the installed skill, creating a remote dependency risk.

low_findings.title: Hardcoded URL
low_findings.confidence_reasoning: Lines 23 through 29 require fetching instructions from an unpinned main branch before every review. Those instructions can change independently of the installed skill, creating a remote dependency risk.

content.value_statement: Documentation can drift from a shared writing standard. This skill retrieves current guidelines and reviews selected files, returning concise findings with file locations.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve the latest writing guidelines with WebFetch before each review.
Read files selected by a user through file paths or patterns.
Ask which files to review when no selection is provided.
Check selected prose against rules supplied by the fetched guidelines.
Report concise findings with file and line references, following the fetched output instructions.
limitations: Requires network access and a compatible WebFetch tool to retrieve the guidelines.
Does not bundle the writing rules or provide an offline fallback.
Review criteria and output instructions can change when the remote guidelines change.
Defines a review workflow, not automatic file editing or factual verification.

use_cases.title: Review product documentation
use_cases.description: Check selected documentation pages against the current writing handbook before publication.

use_cases.title: Check repository prose
use_cases.description: Review README files and documentation changes for writing guideline compliance.

use_cases.title: Audit voice and tone
use_cases.description: Review a selected group of prose files and use location-based findings to organize editorial corrections.

prompt_templates.title: Review one document
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [file] against the current writing guidelines and report findings with file and line references.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: check a single documentation file.

prompt_templates.title: Review a file pattern
prompt_templates.prompt: Review files matching [pattern] against the current writing guidelines. Return concise findings for each affected file.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: check a related group of documents.

prompt_templates.title: Review voice and tone
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [files] against all current writing guidelines, paying particular attention to voice and tone. Keep findings tied to specific lines.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: focus editorial attention without excluding other rules.

prompt_templates.title: Review a bounded document set
prompt_templates.prompt: Review only [file list] against the current writing guidelines. Read the files without editing them and return concise, location-based findings.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: limit review scope before a documentation release.

output_examples.input: Review my documentation for writing guideline compliance.
output_examples.output: Which files or file pattern should I review?

output_examples.input: Illustrative review of a document where line 12 violates a fetched rule favoring direct wording.
output_examples.output: Selected document, line 12: Replace indirect wording with a direct instruction.

best_practices: Specify exact file paths or a narrow pattern to keep the review focused.
Review changes to the remote guidelines before relying on them for sensitive work.
Check each reported location and suggestion before changing published documentation.
anti_patterns: Expecting a complete review when the remote guidelines cannot be retrieved.
Treating style findings as proof of factual accuracy or technical correctness.
Assuming the review workflow automatically rewrites files.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews selected documentation and prose files against rules retrieved from the writing guidelines source.

faq.question: Where do the guidelines come from?
faq.answer: They come from command.md on the main branch of the vercel-labs/writing-guidelines GitHub repository.

faq.question: Does it work offline?
faq.answer: The defined workflow fetches fresh guidelines before every review and includes no offline fallback.

faq.question: What happens when I do not specify files?
faq.answer: The skill asks which files or file pattern you want reviewed.

faq.question: Will it edit my files?
faq.answer: The skill instructs the assistant to report findings. It does not define an automatic editing step.

faq.question: Can review results change between runs?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidelines are fetched from a mutable branch, so review rules and output instructions can change.
